verdict.rationale: The README says each window has its own context, appearance, command history and current directory, and `newWindow` opens new windows while `exit` closes them. Appearance is configurable per window, with `config -p` or `-g` to apply settings globally, and every new window runs `.profile`, which directly covers each element of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-window behavior beyond the first-party README.
